title: Bottomless Brunch with Hayley Di Rito
blurb: Bottomless Brunch with live jazz and swing from Hayley Di Rito. Ninety minutes of bottomless prosecco, draught beer and soft drinks, a make-your-own bubbly cocktail kit, a curated grazing board and live entertainment. £45 per person.

title: Stacey Lynn Crowe
blurb: Stacey Lynn Crowe brings jazz, blues and soul to the Theatre Stage for Saturdays Live, with the grit left in.

title: Bank Holiday Sunday with Tanni Browne
blurb: Bank Holiday Sunday at Moonshine with Tanni Browne performing the Bob Marley songbook live. Free entry, reggae and soul into the night.

title: Velvet Moon
blurb: Velvet Moon bring jazz and soul to the Theatre Stage for Moonshine Fridays. Live from 9.30pm, then DJ Benzo through to 3am.

title: Charmaine: Songs To Be Sung
blurb: Charmaine brings Songs To Be Sung to the Theatre Stage, vintage vocals and the great standards sung the way they were written.

title: Hayley Di Rito
blurb: Hayley Di Rito brings jazz, swing and soul standards to the Theatre Stage for a night of easy, glamorous listening. Expect a voice that fills the room without ever raising it, performed close enough to feel every note.

title: Lisa Morrall & The Peaky Blinders
blurb: Lisa Morrall & The Peaky Blinders bring vintage swing and 1940s style to the Theatre Stage. Expect the Simply Vintage songbook with a full band behind it, and a floor that fills by the second number.

title: Nola Jam Sessions with King Brasstards
blurb: King Brasstards host the Nola Jam Sessions, an open jam welcoming musicians and music lovers for an evening of live collaboration. Bring an instrument or just bring your ears. Free entry, secure your place via Fatsoma.

title: Marcius Riley
blurb: Marcius Riley brings a soulful tribute to Motown and soul classics to the Theatre Stage, from Otis Redding to the Four Tops and beyond. Settle in early, stay late and let DJ Benzo carry the night on.

title: Gareth John Trio
blurb: Leicester vocalist and trumpeter Gareth John leads his trio through jazz and swing standards on the Theatre Stage. Expect horn lines and vocals traded across the front of the room, performed close enough to feel every note.

title: Open Mic Night
blurb: Open Mic Night brings live music, spoken word, poetry, storytelling and comedy to Moonshine. All talent levels are welcome and vintage vibes are encouraged. Performers sign up on the night or by email.
